note: The OLG adequately covers residency verification standards, though organized differently than FNS 831. The Verification Chart (Cross Programs > Verifications > Verification Types) explicitly lists acceptable Massachusetts Residency documents: rent receipt/lease/Landlord Verification form, deed or mortgage statement, Shared Housing Verification form or statement from cohabitant, utility bill, and voter registration — marked as mandatory and not subject to reverification. The VC-1 Q&A page adds that residency can be verified through data sources (RMV, SSA), paystubs, and collateral contact, with self-declaration as a last resort for homeless clients. The Address (RFA) page instructs workers to use the RMV database to verify Massachusetts residency. The Out of State EBT Card Usage Match page provides a detailed table of document currency standards (utility bills within 60 days, active lease terms, rent receipts within 60 days, property tax bills, letters from head of household within 60 days). While the OLG's list does not enumerate every item FNS 831 suggests (e.g., post office records, church/synagogue records, treatment center resident lists, driver's license as a physical document), the FNS list is explicitly 'not limited to' these items — it is a suggestive QC reviewer reference, not a mandatory checklist. The OLG's worker-facing list substantially overlaps and is appropriate for its audience.
